summary: Built backend auth API with 4 Vercel serverless endpoints (register, login, request-password-reset, reset-password) and 4 utility modules (password-hash with bcryptjs salt 10, auth-token with JWT/SECRET_KEY/24h expiry, in-memory user-store keyed by phone_number, reset-code-store with 6-digit codes and 15-min expiry). Registration validates E.164 phone format for North America and Europe. Login returns 401 on bad credentials and JWT on success. Password reset generates a 6-digit code sent via existing Textbelt SMS integration and validates expiry before allowing password update.
